body.about: The physical side of the character: strength, precise movement and energy for long effort.
body.grows: Grows from anything done with the body: sport and training, work on your feet and with your hands, dance, walks, repairs, gardening, cooking, caring for children and family.

mind.about: How the character thinks: knowledge, attention and the ability to stay focused on hard things.
mind.grows: Grows from study and reading hard texts, working with information and code, problem solving, languages, driving and observation, and long focused sessions.

spirit.about: Connection with people and with yourself: leading, empathising and creating.
spirit.grows: Grows from teaching and public speaking, negotiation and sales, caring for people and animals, raising children, art, music, writing and any creative work.

strength.about: Muscle strength and the ability to handle heavy physical work.
strength.grows: Strength training, athletics, carrying loads, construction, warehouse and field work.

dexterity.about: Precision and coordination: body and hands do what you intend.
dexterity.grows: Technical sports, dance, figure skating, musical instruments, handicraft, manual repair, cooking, lab work.

endurance.about: Stamina for long effort. Raises max HP.
endurance.grows: Cardio and walks, shifts on your feet, long physical work, patient care, housekeeping.

intellect.about: Knowledge and the ability to make sense of complex things.
intellect.grows: Study, science, programming, languages, reading hard texts, analysis, medicine, finance.

perception.about: Attention to detail and to what happens around you.
perception.grows: Driving, diagnostics and observation, quality control, drawing from life, lab experiments, security work.

will.about: Discipline and focus: doing hard things for long and regularly.
will.grows: Long focused sessions, hard tasks, consistency, project management, job search, self-learning.

charisma.about: Talking to people, persuading and leading.
charisma.grows: Teaching, public speaking, negotiation, sales, leading people, customer work.

empathy.about: Understanding others and caring for them.
empathy.grows: Psychology, nursing, raising children, supporting family, volunteering, caring for animals.

creativity.grows: Drawing, music, writing, design, photography, handicraft, invention, creative cooking.

attrSheet.progressLine: {stars}/10 stars · {xp} more XP and {days} more active days
attrSheet.rules: Attributes grow slowly and only from real activity: skill experience is split between the skill primary (2/3) and secondary (1/3) attribute. 10 stars give +1 point, but a point also needs several different active days: one marathon is not enough.
attrSheet.unfoldText: When the conditions are met, the System offers to unfold the attribute into three. Their values depend on what you actually invested in. Unfolding is optional: you can keep the general attribute forever.
attrSheet.bonus: Gives: +2% experience to skills where this attribute is primary, per point above 10 (up to +30%).
attrSheet.hpBonus: Gives: +10 max HP per point above 10.

checkin.questionsHint: If it matters, adjust the time on the cards or send a short follow-up report.
checkin.noDrafts: No drafts left: everything is confirmed or deleted.

settings.title: Settings

ai.title: Connect Claude and ChatGPT
ai.intro: Claude can log your activity into Status itself: on the command "log my day" or during a conversation. You connect by signing in to Status, no manual token needed.
ai.label: Token name
ai.freshWarning: The token is shown once. Copy it now: later it is hidden, you can only revoke it and create a new one.
ai.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? The AI connected with it will stop logging activity.
ai.step1: In Claude open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
ai.step3: Leave Advanced settings (OAuth Client ID and Secret) empty, click Add, then Connect.
ai.step4: A Status page opens: sign in if asked and click Allow.
ai.step5: Enable the connector in a chat and write "log my day".
ai.instructionsHint: Add this to Claude Settings → Profile → instructions so that "log my day" works reliably.
ai.instructions:
I have the Status connector (a levelling tracker). When I write "log my day":
1) find today's conversations; 2) call list_skills and get_day;
3) make a list of activities with an honest estimate of focused time (not chat length)
and show it to me; 4) after my "ok", call log_activities.
During normal conversations, log activity only when I ask.
ai.chatgpt: In ChatGPT, connectors are added in Developer mode in the apps settings. The address is the same; sign-in also goes through the Status page.
ai.manualHint: For clients that let you set request headers: create a token and add the header authorization with the value "Bearer …".

settings.autoHint: By default entries from Claude arrive as drafts and wait for your confirmation in the Journal.

oauth.title: [System] Access request
oauth.question: {client} asks for access to your Status character.
oauth.canRead: see your level, skills, attributes and activity entries;
oauth.canWrite: add activity entries (as drafts unless auto-confirm is on) and suggest skills;
oauth.cannot: it cannot take skills or change attributes and settings.
oauth.returnTo: After you answer we return to {host}
oauth.invalid: The access request was not found or has expired. Start connecting in Claude again.
oauth.revokeHint: You can revoke access any time: Settings → Connect Claude.

sections.p: Status is a personal app that turns your activities, sleep and well-being into character progress. This page explains what data it keeps and why.

Your email and name from your Google account (if you sign in with Google). What you enter yourself: activity entries, skills, sleep, well-being, evening report texts, settings and your character’s look. Technical data: sign-in times and tokens for connected AI assistants.
Only to run the app: to compute experience, levels and attributes and show them to you. We do not sell data, show ads, or share data for advertising.

Supabase (database and sign-in, servers in Canada), Vercel (website hosting), Anthropic (Claude parses the text of your evening report and onboarding story; only that text and skill names are sent). If you connect Claude or ChatGPT via MCP yourself, the assistant reads and writes your Status data on your behalf.

When you sign in with Google we receive only your email, name and avatar (openid, email, profile). The app has no access to Gmail, Drive or other Google services. Use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
Only essential ones: your sign-in session and chosen language. No analytics or advertising cookies.
You can revoke AI assistant tokens in Settings. To delete your account and all data, email the support address shown on the Google sign-in screen; we delete it within 30 days.
